objective: Replicar exactamente los CTE h/l/t de _extract_mpro para 130QRO sucursal 0021 en 08/08/2026 y localizar todo ticket KPI con bruto total <=0 que puede disparar MPRO_NO_DISTRIBUTABLE_DETAIL.

queries.name: qro_0808_exact_extractor_zero_gross
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
    SELECT
        v.Vn_Folio,
        v.Vn_Documento,
        v.Vn_Fecha,
        v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal,
        ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado, '') AS estado_origen,
        ISNULL(c.Co_Personas, 0) AS pax_ticket,
        CAST(ISNULL(v.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe, 0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS importe_neto_ticket,
        ISNULL(c.Co_Propina, 0) AS propina_ticket,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(18,4)) AS descuento_comanda,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(18,4)) AS descuento_ticket
    FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN Comanda c WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON c.Co_Folio = v.Vn_Documento
     AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal = v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal
    WHERE CONVERT(date, v.Vn_Fecha) >= CONVERT(date, '2026-08-08 00:00:00')
      AND CONVERT(date, v.Vn_Fecha) < CONVERT(date, '2026-08-09 00:00:00')
      AND v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal = '0021'
      AND ISNULL(v.Vn_Tabla, '') = 'Comanda'
      AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado, '') IN ('AC', 'FA', 'CA')
),
l AS (
    SELECT
        h.Vn_Folio,
        h.Vn_Documento,
        h.Vn_Fecha,
        h.estado_origen,
        h.pax_ticket,
        h.importe_neto_ticket,
        CASE
          WHEN MAX(d.Co_Folio) IS NULL THEN 'HEADER_SIN_DETALLE'
          ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(varchar(100), d.Pr_Cve_Producto), ''), 'SIN_CODIGO')
        END AS producto_codigo_fuente,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Cantidad, 0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS cantidad,
        CASE
          WHEN SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Cantidad, 0) AS decimal(18,4))) <> 0
          THEN SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Importe, 0) AS decimal(18,4)))
               / SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Cantidad, 0) AS decimal(18,4)))
          ELSE MAX(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Precio, 0) AS decimal(18,4)))
        END AS precio_unitario,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Importe, 0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS importe_bruto
    FROM h
    LEFT JOIN Comanda_Detalle d WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON d.Co_Folio = h.Vn_Documento
     AND ISNULL(d.Es_Cve_Estado, '') IN ('AC', 'FA')
    GROUP BY
        h.Vn_Folio,h.Vn_Documento,h.Vn_Fecha,h.estado_origen,
        h.pax_ticket,h.importe_neto_ticket,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(varchar(100), d.Pr_Cve_Producto), ''), 'SIN_CODIGO')
),
t AS (
    SELECT Vn_Folio,
           COUNT(*) AS lineas_l,
           CAST(SUM(importe_bruto) AS decimal(18,4)) AS bruto_ticket,
           MIN(importe_neto_ticket) AS neto_min,
           MAX(importe_neto_ticket) AS neto_max
    FROM l
    WHERE estado_origen IN ('AC','FA')
    GROUP BY Vn_Folio
)
SELECT TOP 100
       t.Vn_Folio,t.lineas_l,t.bruto_ticket,t.neto_min,t.neto_max,
       MIN(l.Vn_Documento) AS Vn_Documento,
       MIN(l.estado_origen) AS estado_origen,
       MIN(l.producto_codigo_fuente) AS producto_min,
       MAX(l.producto_codigo_fuente) AS producto_max,
       SUM(l.cantidad) AS cantidad_total,
       MAX(l.precio_unitario) AS precio_max
FROM t
JOIN l ON l.Vn_Folio=t.Vn_Folio
WHERE t.bruto_ticket <= 0
GROUP BY t.Vn_Folio,t.lineas_l,t.bruto_ticket,t.neto_min,t.neto_max
ORDER BY t.Vn_Folio
